key_insight: Multifidelity Operator Inference improves reduced-order PDE predictions by combining scarce high-fidelity training data with abundant low-fidelity data.
engineering_relevance: More accurate, lower-variance surrogates can make repeated PDE evaluations more practical for uncertainty quantification and engineering design optimization.
method: Fit reduced operators non-intrusively using state and time-derivative data.
Supplement scarce high-fidelity snapshots with data from coarser discretizations.
Combine fidelity levels through multifidelity linear regression.
evidence_signal: Experiments on model PDE problems show higher solution-field accuracy than high-fidelity-only Operator Inference at the same computational budget.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish performance on complex engineering systems; benefits may depend on how informative coarse-grid data are.
paper_title: Multifidelity Operator Inference for Non-intrusive Model Reduction under Data Scarcity
